brief.scope: The fixture apps batch, slice 4 (apps/symfony-app), the skeptic pass: judge the test on this ref against the contract in the input file (the fixture scope and the plan for slices 3 to 5; the slice 4 section). The test is landed on this ref, red first: ops/devlane/fixtures/tests/test_symfony_app_app.py, proving the app through the lever ops/bin/fixture.sh (make, prove red on every planted fault and green on every clean neighbour, prove --fixed green, the manifest sweep, grade) with the toolchain the plan names (composer from a warm cache, phpunit), and pinning the lever change the plan assigns to this slice (probe_timeout, the preflight ignore list) on a synthetic app. Judge whether it discriminates, whether every fault the plan assigns is pinned with its span and probe, whether the probes prove red mechanically, and whether a wrong app, a wrong FAULTS.json or an unchanged lever would pass. No implementation exists yet; do not write one.

findings.claim: The lock assertion rejects a contract-correct Composer lock: it requires every symfony/* package to use v8.1.*, including symfony/flex, although the contract requires Flex ^2 and measures v2.11.0.
findings.reproduce: PYTHONPATH=ops/devlane/fixtures/tests python3 -c 'import unittest; from unittest.mock import patch; import test_symfony_app_app as m; c=m.SymfonyAppLayout("test_composer_lock_pins_symfony_v81"); r=unittest.TestResult(); d={"content-hash":"x","packages":[{"name":"symfony/flex","version":"v2.11.0"}]}; p=patch.object(m,"load_json_object",return_value=d); p.start(); c.run(r); p.stop(); print(len(r.failures),len(r.errors)); assert len(r.failures)==1 and not r.errors'

findings.claim: Implementation-authored manifest commands and probes are treated as the behavioral oracle. A wrong app can place dirty tokens in dead code and use source-grep probes that turn green after textual patches; no test independently exercises the seven specified fault behaviors.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("ops/devlane/fixtures/tests/test_symfony_app_app.py").read_text(); t=("CommandTester","../outside.txt","renderCount(0)","FIXTURE_TOKEN","LedgerException","contains(3)","Checksum::of"); m=[x for x in t if x not in s]; print(m); assert len(m)==len(t)'

findings.claim: The check assertions match command-name tokens and then accept exit zero; they do not prove composer validate, php -l, or PHPUnit ran. A no-op check with every command behind a successful `true ||` arm passes.
findings.reproduce: PYTHONPATH=ops/devlane/fixtures/tests python3 -c 'import subprocess; s="true || composer validate --strict; true || php -l src tests; true || vendor/bin/phpunit"; assert all(x in s for x in ("composer validate --strict","php -l","src","tests","vendor/bin/phpunit")); p=subprocess.run(["bash","-c",s]); print(p.returncode); assert p.returncode==0'

findings.claim: The per-ID manifest oracle pins only kind and visibility, omitting each assigned severity, location, probe, and fix. A wrong FAULTS.json can downgrade severities or remap IDs to other shape-matching spans and probes.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("ops/devlane/fixtures/tests/test_symfony_app_app.py").read_text(); a=s.index("EXPECTED_KIND_VISIBLE"); z=s.index("COMPOSER_REQUIRE",a); b=s[a:z]; m=[x for x in ("severity","location","probe","fix") if x not in b]; print(m); assert len(m)==4 and "row.get(\"severity\")" not in s and "EXPECTED_SEVER" not in s'

findings.claim: The custom timeout is tested only through `prove`, not `prove --fixed`; a lever retaining the two-second timeout for fixed probes passes. Integer/range validation is also under-pinned: valid boundaries 1/300 and invalid booleans, fractions, and negative integers are absent.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("ops/devlane/fixtures/tests/test_symfony_app_app.py").read_text(); a=s.index("def test_probe_timeout_five"); z=s.index("def test_prove_fixed_ignores",a); b=s[a:z]; print("fixed", "[\"prove\", \"--fixed\"" in b, "invalid", "(\"x\", 0, 301)" in b); assert "[\"prove\", \"--fixed\"" not in b and "(\"x\", 0, 301)" in b'

findings.claim: The contract assigns six preflight exclusions, but the test plants only vendor, target, and .venv. A lever that still copies var, .phpunit.cache, and node_modules passes.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("ops/devlane/fixtures/tests/test_symfony_app_app.py").read_text(); b=s[s.index("def test_prove_fixed_ignores_vendor"):s.index("if __name__ ==",s.index("def test_prove_fixed_ignores_vendor"))]; r=("vendor/","target/",".venv/","var/",".phpunit.cache/","node_modules/"); m=[x for x in r if x not in b]; print(m); assert m==["var/",".phpunit.cache/","node_modules/"]'

findings.claim: Fix confinement examines only removed old-line numbers and never enforces one hunk. A patch can remove the fault inside its span and add a second, addition-only hunk elsewhere in the same file without detection.
findings.reproduce:
PYTHONPATH=ops/devlane/fixtures/tests python3 -c 'from test_symfony_app_app import _patch_removed_lines; p="diff --git a/src/X.php b/src/X.php
--- a/src/X.php
+++ b/src/X.php
@@ -10 +10 @@
-bad
+good
@@ -100,0 +101 @@
+backdoor
"; print(_patch_removed_lines(p)); assert _patch_removed_lines(p)=={"src/X.php":[10]}'

findings.claim: Every non-zero Composer install becomes a skip. A malformed or inconsistent app lock can therefore suppress the app check and all seven behavioral proofs; that is a wrong app, not an unavailable host.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("ops/devlane/fixtures/tests/test_symfony_app_app.py").read_text(); a=s.index("def install_or_skip"); z=s.index("def test_make_symfony_app",a); b=s[a:z]; hit="if proc.returncode != 0:" in b and "self.skipTest(" in b[b.index("if proc.returncode != 0:"):]; print(hit); assert hit'

envelope.note: The intended missing-FAULTS.json red and the plant guard were verified. No implementation was read. The review sandbox was read-only and rejected writing SKEPTIC.md; scratch-based runtime cases were likewise unreachable, so the requested artifact path is named but was not created.
